messages.collect.lead: Paste a link, pick an artist, set up a search, or pull in your own bookmarks. The download queue takes care of the rest.
messages.collect.note: You can also install the companion userscripts and add tasks straight from Pixiv pages.

messages.collect.s1.desc: Paste one link or a whole batch and they go straight into the queue.

messages.collect.s2.desc: Fetch everything an artist has posted.
messages.collect.s2.name: Artists
messages.collect.s3.desc: Search by keyword, filter the results, then download them in bulk.
messages.collect.s3.name: Search
messages.collect.s4.desc: Save manga and novel series as complete sets, in order.
messages.collect.s4.name: Series
messages.collect.s5.desc: Pull in your own bookmarks, new works from users you follow, and your collections.
messages.collect.s5.name: My bookmarks

From a single link

Give the art you love
a home of its own.

messages.formats.c1.body: Keep the original format, or save PNG, JPG or WebP copies alongside it.
messages.formats.c1.title: Illustrations and manga
messages.formats.c2.body: Convert ugoira to WebP, GIF, APNG or MP4, or keep the original ZIP.
messages.formats.c2.title: Ugoira
messages.formats.c3.body: Save as TXT, HTML or EPUB. A series can be bound into a single book.
messages.formats.c3.title: Novels

messages.formats.title:
Saved
the way you want.

messages.gallery.demo.label: Tag filter
messages.gallery.f1.body: File works into collections you create and sort them your own way.
messages.gallery.f1.title: Local collections
messages.gallery.f2.body: Perceptual hashing finds works that look alike, which makes clearing out duplicates easier.
messages.gallery.f2.title: Suspected duplicates
messages.gallery.f3.body: Pack the works you select into a ZIP and take them with you.
messages.gallery.f3.title: Bulk export
messages.gallery.lead: The author, tags and rating of every work are recorded in a local database. Set tags to include or exclude, and combine them into exactly the range you want to see.
messages.gallery.title:
It only counts
if you can find it.
messages.hero.badge: Open source · Runs on your own computer
messages.hero.lead: PixivDownloader saves illustrations, manga, ugoira and novels from Pixiv to your disk, then organizes them into a local gallery you can search and read.
messages.hero.title:
The art you love,
kept in your hands.
messages.more.b1.body: Check for updates in the background on a fixed interval or a cron expression. New works from your artists are added automatically.
messages.more.b1.note: Checks for new works every day at 03:00
messages.more.b1.title: Scheduled tasks
messages.more.b2.body: When your login expires, access is restricted or tasks keep failing, you get an alert by email and push notification.
messages.more.b2.title: It tells you when something breaks
messages.more.b3.body: Issue invite codes so friends see only the tags, authors and ratings you allow.
messages.more.b3.title: Read-only guests
messages.more.b4.body: Search the full text, translate it, or let AI read it aloud with a voice for each character.
messages.more.b4.title: Novels are more than files
messages.more.b5.body: Install the features you need from the plugin market, or write your own plugin with the public SDK.
messages.more.b5.title: Plugins and SDK
messages.more.b6.body: A desktop interface is included. Records are stored in SQLite by default, and you can switch to PostgreSQL.
messages.more.b6.title: Desktop interface and database
messages.more.b7.body: Switch the interface language and the light or dark theme at any time. This page works the same way.
messages.more.b7.title: Languages and dark mode
messages.more.title:
Leave it alone.
It keeps working.
